canonical_summary: A roughly square marsh can have four exposures if it is enclosed by walls; one faces east, one faces south, one faces west and one faces north. It would be better if a marsh could be planted in a northern exposure. Market gardeners consider that the soil of their marshes produce larger and more beautiful vegetables.
